owner_note.text: The rest of Phase 1 is on michael/dev. A cleared field stays cleared after a reload. One action now saves one line per item (a page edit went from 3 lines to 2), and typing saves one line per burst instead of one per key. A page whose log is rewritten underneath it recovers without applying a line twice. Every saved record replays exactly as before. To turn on the rewrite recovery, the dev server needs a restart (I didn't restart it). Choice I made: in the browser, a single field change now waits up to 300 ms before it saves; the alternative was to send the first change at once.
